note: Research tally. A hit is an observed checkpoint where every measured series (price and liquidity) moves the whale's way at +1h, +6h, or +24h. A wrong-way observation is a miss. No observation is unobserved and is not a miss. n_observed is hits plus misses. Rates stay blank under 8 observed checkpoints on that horizon in that tally. scores.live is the forward quote path, or the lead's published private-cache tally. scores.backfill is approximate: nearest desk-data ADA/qty within 20 minutes at 1h, 60 minutes at 6h, and 3 hours at 24h, plus pool ADA when a snapshot is in that window. Backfill never replaces live. eligible_for_active needs at least 25 live observed checkpoints and a live hit rate above 55% at both 6h and 24h. promising_backfill means the approximate tally alone would clear that bar. Nothing is promoted automatically. Not a buy signal.

whales.eligible_reason: not eligible: live 6h observed 0 (need 25), rate blank (need > 0.55); live 24h observed 0 (need 25), rate blank (need > 0.55); promotion is a manual owner decision
